verdict.rationale: Letta doesn't offer an explicit region/residency picker for its cloud service, but self-hosting lets users run agents entirely on infrastructure they control, with all state kept on-device and no Letta account required, giving indirect control over data location. missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection controls within Letta Cloud, documentation of where cloud-hosted data/backups are stored geographically, any compliance (GDPR/data-residency) statements
